device.modelDescription: reports its own progress through ctx.job.progress (MCP completeness M21)

actionList.name: work
actionList.description: Reports 10, 50 and 90, 300 ms apart, then answers.

actionList.name: flood
actionList.description: Reports progress 100,000 times at once, waits 600 ms, then answers.

actionList.name: bad
actionList.description: Reports values outside 0..100 and non-numbers, then answers.

actionList.name: late
actionList.description: Answers at once, then reports 50 after 100 ms.

actionList.name: jobshape
actionList.description: Returns what ctx.job is outside a task: its id and the error from info.

actionList.name: echo
actionList.description: Reports 50, then returns its input as it got it.
